chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
Regarding a man who performs ziyarah and sleeps before Mina, he said: When he has passed the pass of al-Madaineen, there is no harm in him sleeping.

key_terms.عَقَبَةَ الْمَدِينِينَ: The pass or mountain pass of al-Madaineen, a specific landmark near Mecca.
key_terms.مِنًي: Mina, a plain near Mecca where pilgrims spend the days of Tashriq.
key_terms.يَزُورُ: He performs ziyarah (visitation), typically referring to visiting the Prophet or Imams or performing Umrah.

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible for a pilgrim to sleep before reaching Mina after performing ziyarah?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani's chain clarifies the specific boundary for pilgrims performing ziyarah, permitting them to rest after passing the 'Aqabah of al-Madaineen rather than requiring them to stay in Mina overnight. It reflects the Shia juristic distinction between the obligations of Hajj residence and the flexibility granted to those visiting the Imam's shrine, emphasizing ease in ritual practice.
